identity.name: E1
identity.mission: Create a Civil Air Patrol (CAP) Encampment Roster that feels authoritative, tactical, and militarily precise. Avoid generic SaaS aesthetics. Prioritize density and clarity.

theme.description: A clean, white-dominant interface with deep navy (#00205B) for structure and bold red (#BF0D3E) for critical actions. The aesthetic should feel like a modern military command center—functional, not decorative.

headings.usage: Use for all page titles, section headers, and major metrics. Must be uppercase for H1/H2.

body.usage: General UI text, labels, and descriptions.

mono.usage: CAPIDs, financial figures, budget codes, tabular data.

layout.strategy: Dashboard First. Use a sidebar navigation (collapsible) to maximize horizontal space for data tables. Dashboard should use a 12-column grid where widgets span 3, 4, or 6 columns based on importance.
layout.container_style: Sharp corners (rounded-none or rounded-sm). 1px solid borders. No drop shadows for cards—use borders to define hierarchy.

Button.style: Sharp corners (rounded-sm), uppercase text, tracking-wide, font-bold.

Card.header: border-b border-slate-100 p-4 font-heading uppercase tracking-tight text-[#00205B]

Table.style: dense, compact, alternating rows (zebra striping: even:bg-slate-50)
Table.header: bg-[#00205B] text-white uppercase text-xs tracking-wider sticky top-0 z-10
Table.cell: py-2 px-3 text-sm font-mono border-b border-slate-200

Badge.style: rounded-sm px-2 py-0.5 text-[10px] uppercase tracking-wider font-bold

visual_enhancers.textures: Subtle noise on the main background (#F8FAFC) to reduce sterility.
visual_enhancers.icons: Lucide-react. Use thin strokes (1.5px) for a technical look.
visual_enhancers.charts: Recharts. Use simple bar and line charts. Avoid 3D or donut charts unless strictly necessary for 'parts of a whole'.
visual_enhancers.logo_fallback: Use a shield or plane icon if the official logo fails to load.

accessibility.contrast: Ensure text contrast ratio is at least 4.5:1. Blue text on white meets this. Red text should only be used on white backgrounds.
accessibility.focus_states: Visible focus ring (2px solid #00205B) on all interactive elements.

instructions_to_main_agent: Use 'Barlow Condensed' or 'Chivo' from Google Fonts for headings. Add import to index.css.
Use 'Inter' for body and 'JetBrains Mono' for data.
Create a 'Sidebar' layout component that persists across all authenticated pages.
The 'Roster' page is the core feature. It must handle 100+ rows efficiently. Use virtualization if necessary, or simple pagination.
Implement 'Role-Based Access Control' logic in the frontend (e.g., a simple 'useRole' hook) to show/hide edit buttons.
For the 'Financial Tracker', use a dense grid of summary cards at the top, followed by a detailed transaction table.
Ensure the 'Login' page looks official—use the CAP logo and a clean form on a split background (image left, form right).
UNIVERSAL_GUIDELINES_FOR_MAIN_AGENT: You tend to converge toward generic outputs. Avoid this: make it look 'Tactical' and 'Official'.
Dark colors look good when used independently without gradients. DO NOT use dark colors as gradients.
Don't make generic centered layouts. Use grids.
Create depth through borders and subtle background differences, not heavy shadows.
You MUST NOT apply universal transition 'transition: all'.
You MUST NOT center align the app container.
Every interaction needs micro-animations - hover states, transitions.
Use 2-3x more spacing than feels comfortable in layout containers, but KEEP DATA DENSE.
Subtle grain textures, noise overlays, custom cursors: separates good from extraordinary.
Missing categories (especially sponsor logos) = main agent will use placeholder text which is FORBIDDEN. Use the provided logo URL.
